dimensions.assessment: Applies nationwide to individuals and organizations by removing certain minor criminal liabilities and permitting original design metal coins.
dimensions.evidence: permits individuals and organizations to make and pass metal coins intended for use as real money so long as the coins are of original design

dimensions.assessment: De-criminalizes minor infractions such as writing small checks, removing mail stamps, or sledding on Capitol grounds.
dimensions.evidence: repeals various federal misdemeanor offenses... including... writing a check for less than $1... removing a stamp from a piece of mail... using the Capitol Grounds as a playground

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue changes are stated, other than minor potential reductions in enforcement/prosecution costs.
Amends Title 18, Title 21, Title 46, Title 7, and Title 2 of the U.S. Code by repealing specific federal misdemeanor provisions.
dimensions.evidence: Section 336 of title 18, United States Code, is repealed... Subsections (b), (c), and (d) of section 407 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act... are repealed.

dimensions.assessment: Permanently removes the specified federal criminal statutes and misdemeanor penalties from federal law.
dimensions.evidence: To repeal certain unnecessary criminal offenses, and for other purposes.

missing_information: The number of individuals prosecuted annually under the repealed misdemeanor statutes is not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill repeals specific federal misdemeanor offenses and minor regulations, and modifies intent requirements for others, affecting federal criminal statutes.
